name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Hi-Q Houston Saunas offer everyone a chance to live a better life. Whether it is allergies that make your life miserable, excess weight, sport injuries, aches, acne, or stress – Infrared therapy offers the solution to these problems, among many others. Infrared saunas have proven over the years their efficiency in assisting with many troubles modern people have.



Revolutionary approach to technology, top quality materials used for inside and out, certified experts that make each unit, special care to the smallest details – everything is combined to make each Infrared sauna to last long and grant joy and a vast number of health benefits with each use.



The first and one of the most important benefits from Infrared light therapy is detoxification. Toxins find their way into the human body through the air we breathe, the food we eat, the drinks we have – and toxins build up over the years, bringing many problems – from bad skin to bad blood flow and poor healing processes. Infrared therapy is a proved way to quickly and safely detoxify the body in a natural way, aiding the body to become healthier and more beautiful.
